sources.title: VoxCPM 1.5 | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: VoxCPM1.5 is the latest VoxCPM tokenizer-free text-to-speech model from OpenBMB and ModelBest. It directly produces continuous speech representations from text for expressive, context-aware synthesis and highly realistic zero-shot voice cloning in Chinese and English.

sources.title: VoxCPM1.5 · Models
sources.snippet: VoxCPM1.5 supports both full fine-tuning (SFT) and LoRA fine-tuning, allowing you to train personalized voice models on your own data. See the Fine-tuning Guide for detailed instructions.
